L0153

`{type}.State.{state}` is unreachable from every entry transition.

What

`{type}.State.{state}` is unreachable from every entry transition.

Why

When a state graph has entry transitions, no entry path reaches this state. It may be an unused branch or a state name that is not connected to the protocol.

Fix

add an entry or transition path to `{state}`, or remove it from the declaration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0153: tests/ui_lint/typestate_unreachable.warn.

Warning [L0153] (unreachable_state): `Flow.State.Orphan` is unreachable from every entry transition.
  --> tests/ui_lint/typestate_unreachable.jet:2:26
    |
  2 |     state { Start, Done, Orphan }
    |                          ^^^^^^
 Why: when a state graph has entry transitions, no entry path reaches this state. It may be an unused branch or a state name that is not connected to the protocol.
 Fix: add an entry or transition path to `Orphan`, or remove it from the declaration.
